title: "Tidy Tuesday"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-20"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(tinytable)
library(maps)
library(ggthemes)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)

# Download TidyTuesday data
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load("2026-05-19")

# Find what datasets are present for this week
names(tuesdata)

# Name datasets
member_part <- tuesdata$member_participation_stats_by_country
metadata <- tuesdata$metadata_coverage_stats_by_country

readme(tuesdata)
```

```{r view-data, warning=FALSE}
# View the structure of each dataset
glimpse(member_part)
glimpse(metadata)

```

Okay so, from what I understand about the data, member_part is one row per country and counts how many publishers in that country have deposited each type of metadata. The other dataset is a row per country plus a document type and counts how many individual papers have each type of metadata. 

```{r exploring, warning=FALSE}
latest <- member_part %>%
  filter(current_up_to == max(current_up_to))

latest <- latest %>%
  mutate(pct_orcid_authors = deposits_orcid_for_authors / total_members)

latest %>%
  filter(total_members >= 10) %>%
  select(iso3_code, region_id, total_members, deposits_orcid_for_authors, pct_orcid_authors) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_orcid_authors)) %>%
  head(20)

latest %>%
  filter(total_members >= 10) %>%
  select(iso3_code, region_id, total_members, deposits_orcid_for_authors, pct_orcid_authors) %>%
  arrange(pct_orcid_authors) %>%
  head(20)

latest %>%
  filter(total_members >= 10) %>%
  count(region_id)
```

```{r graph, warning=FALSE}
region_summary <- latest %>%
  filter(total_members >= 10) %>%
  group_by(region_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_members = sum(total_members),
    total_orcid = sum(deposits_orcid_for_authors),
    pct_orcid = total_orcid / total_members
  )

region_summary

region_labels <- c(
  EAS = "East Asia & Pacific",
  ECS = "Europe & Central Asia",
  LCN = "Latin America & Caribbean",
  MEA = "Middle East & North Africa",
  NAC = "North America",
  SAS = "South Asia",
  SSF = "Sub-Saharan Africa"
)

# Colors
bg       <- "#0d0d0d"
bar_dark <- "#3d2040"
pink_hi  <- "#ff3da6"
text_hi  <- "#ffffff"
text_mut <- "#888888"

# Create plot_data
plot_data <- region_summary %>%
  mutate(
    region_name = region_labels[region_id],
    region_name = fct_reorder(region_name, pct_orcid),
    highlight = region_id == "LCN"
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = pct_orcid, y = region_name, fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(pct_orcid, accuracy = 1)),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = text_hi
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(plot_data, highlight),
    aes(x = pct_orcid + 0.06, label = "leads the world"),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "italic",
    color = pink_hi
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#ff3da6", "FALSE" = bar_dark)) +  # brighter pink
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.8, 0.8))) +  # gap between bars and edges
  labs(
  title = "Who's identifying their <span style='color:#ff3da6'>researchers?</span>",
  subtitle = "<span style='color:#ff3da6'><b>TIDYTUESDAY 2026 · WEEK 20 · CROSSREF</b></span><br><br>Share of publishers per region that include author ORCID IDs<br>in at least one deposited work · members with 10+ registered DOIs only",
  caption = "Source: Crossref via #TidyTuesday 2026 Week 20  ·  ORCID = Open Researcher & Contributor ID"
) +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = bg, color = NA),
    plot.title.position = "plot",        # <-- add here
    plot.caption.position = "plot",      # <-- and here
    plot.title    = ggtext::element_markdown(
      color = text_hi, size = 26, face = "bold",
      margin = margin(b = 4),
      hjust = 0
    ),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(
      color = text_mut, size = 11, lineheight = 1.5,
      margin = margin(b = 20),
      hjust = 0
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      color = "#555555", size = 9, hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 20)
    ),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(
      color = ifelse(
        levels(plot_data$region_name) == "Latin America & Caribbean",
        "#ffffff", "#aaaaaa"
      ),
      size = 11, hjust = 1, lineheight = 1.3,
      margin = margin(r = 12)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(30, 60, 20, 30)
  )
```
